Leasing and cash holdings of fitness firms

Abstract

We study published annual accounts of 80 fitness firms.

2. Methods

We estimate an OLS regression with fixed effects on firm accounts. No ethics approval was required because no human participants were involved.

3. Results

Firms that lease hold more cash.
